title: Why Indian fans are so toxic?
description:
Checkout Odoo Invoicing: https://www.odoo.com/r/sMc

India’s toxic fan culture has taken over cricket, entertainment, and politics—where admiration often turns into blind worship. In cricket, fans troll players after one bad match, forgetting years of contribution. In films, actors are either treated like gods or targeted with hate, depending on which "camp" they belong to. And in politics, leaders are followed with cult-like devotion, where logic, criticism, or accountability vanish in favour of loyalty.

This extreme obsession kills healthy debate, silences opposing views, and turns social media into a battlefield. Appreciation is good—but blind devotion? That’s where the toxicity begins.
